stemMd: A rectangle has side lengths 9 and 12. What is its diagonal length?
explanationMd: The diagonal is the hypotenuse of a right triangle. Its square is 9 squared+12 squared=81+144=225, so the diagonal is 15.

distractorRationale.c: This adds sides rather than applying Pythagoras.
distractorRationale.a: This is the difference of the sides.
